associate.name: Associate Sponsor
associate.description: Support culture and community with entry-level brand recognition.
features: Logo/name on sponsor section of website

silver.name: Silver Sponsor
silver.description: Increase your visibility while supporting our cultural events.
features: Logo on selected posters or digital event creatives

gold.name: Gold Sponsor
gold.description: Showcase your brand as a key supporter of cultural excellence.
features: Premium logo placement on website and event screen
Half-page sponsor feature in event program/page
Opportunity to present an award or address audience briefly, if event format allows

platinum.name: Platinum Sponsor
platinum.description: Maximum visibility. Become a leading partner in our cultural mission.
features: Recognition as Main Partner / Presenting Sponsor where applicable
Full-page sponsor feature in event program/page
Premium logo placement on main stage/screen and campaign creatives
Brand mention in press/media communication where applicable
Meet & greet or networking opportunity where applicable

custom.name: Tailored Sponsorship
custom.description: Choose any amount that fits your budget and partnership goals.

reason3.title: Brand Visibility
